items.title: dsh-superagent (GitHub Repo)
items.snippet: dsh-superagent is a coding agent packaged as a bundle for DeepSeek Harness. It can watch GitHub, open work items, work in its own agent session and directory, and answer in the original conversation.

items.title: Supporting a shared AI training control for websites (2 minute read)
